snippet.title: It Takes A War - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
From the creator of The Corridor comes It Takes a War — a team-based shooter with visceral gunplay and relentless action. Prepare to drop into a devastatingly real depiction of the battlefield where survival hinges on communication.

Choose one of three unique combat classes, coordinate with your squad via voice chat, wield realistic weapons and engage in pure tactical combat. No distractions — just raw, team-oriented warfare.

Wishlist now on Steam for the Q4 2025 launch. Victory awaits those who fight together.
